newsitem.title: UK: Prov Fin says to repurchase 6.3 pct shr cap.
newsitem.headline: Prov Fin says to repurchase 6.3 pct shr cap.

text.p: British credit and insurance group Provident Financial Plc said on Monday it intended to repurchase up to 17 million shares representing about 6.3 percent of its issued ordinary capital.
"The company intends to make market purchases of its shares during the next year as and when market conditions are favourable," it said.
Provident's share price was marked 19 1/2p higher at 621 as the announcement was made.
The company said the purchases will be made through its joint brokers Dresdner Kleinwort Benson and ABN-Amro Hoare Govett.

"The directors of the company believe that the implementation of the programme will result in a more efficient capital structure for the company and the enhancement of earnings per share in future years," the company said in a statement.
